# HEAD LICE (PEDICULOSIS CAPITIS)

Lice are parasitic insects. Human lice survive by feeding on human blood. To make a diagnosis, use a nit comb, bright light, or lens to find a louse living on the scalp. Dead nits may remain for months after successful treatment. Dead nits are usually located more than 6 mm from the scalp. Lice are often transmitted by infected clothing and bedclothes but not by ordinary furniture that is not typically in contact with hair or scalp.

Refer to the following for advice on household cleaning for lice infestations: https://www.cdc.gov/lice/treatment/index.html
